product_one_liner.value: WindBorne combines atmospheric observations from long-duration balloons with proprietary AI models to deliver weather forecasts and decision tools for individuals, enterprises and government users.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer, and the /pricing URL did not yield a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: NOAA is explicitly identified as an operational customer; the Air Force is identified through paid atmospheric-observation contracts.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists a headcount of 103; older third-party profiles report lower counts.

hq_location.notes: The company describes its base as Redwood Shores, California; its listed city is Redwood City.

founded_year.notes: The company's blog explicitly refers to its founding in 2019.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include AI data assimilation by ML engineer Jack Michaels and WeatherMesh-4 architecture by ML engineer Haoxing Du.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation covers authentication, SDK/CLI usage, forecast models, observations, weather events and webhooks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: An open Machine Learning Research Engineer, Model Evaluation posting includes an application link.

model_provider.value: WindBorne's proprietary WeatherMesh, including WeatherMesh-6, and MetaMesh models.
model_provider.notes: These are its own weather-forecasting models, rather than a disclosed third-party general-purpose LLM provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal, privacy and security disclosures name none of the five requested compliance claims.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn records the round on July 31, 2026 at $37,124,969; WindBorne publicly announced it on August 5, 2026 as a $37 million Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The $37 million Series B announced August 5, 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An open Enterprise Account Executive — Utilities posting includes an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: WindBorne launched Weather Events through its API on October 29, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership section lists founder CEO, CTO and CPO roles and no VP. No qualifying appointment or departure announcement was found; individual start dates are not published.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The reviewed sales and GTM postings name no specific CRM or marketing platform; the AE posting refers only to a generic CRM.
